Author: The Kinship
Name: Rafter Cat's Looking Glass
Punchline: A mod previewer and information bank for your Penumbra mods.
Description:
A searchable list of every mod in your Penumbra folder, so you can find that one shirt without trying on fifty mods. Type /lookingglass or /lglass to open.

- Search by name, Penumbra folder, author or tags
- Scroll through with the arrow keys
- Shows where each mod sits in your Penumbra folders, with a Copy name button

It only reads your Penumbra mod list. It doesn't change your mods, and nothing goes online.
Changelog:
0.5.2: Fixed Glamourer dressing during photo sessions (the "no dye" value wasn't reaching Glamourer in a form it could read).
0.5.1: When Glamourer or Penumbra report a problem, the Looking Glass now shows their actual error and which step failed, instead of "isn't answering".
0.5.0: Glamourer dressing for photo sessions. With "Also dress me with Glamourer" ticked, your current look is saved when the session starts, Glamourer puts on the item each mod replaces so the mod actually shows, and your look is put back before each next mod (no leftover pieces) and when the session ends. Glamourer designs, automation and glamour plates are never changed. If your look can't be saved first, it won't dress you.
0.4.0: Photo session. Press Start photo session and every mod you pick is put on you temporarily, one at a time (the last one comes off first), so you can arrow through and screenshot each. Ending the session or closing the window puts everything back; nothing in Penumbra is saved or changed. Each card now shows what the mod replaces ("Wear this for it to show"). New Show in Penumbra button opens Penumbra right at that mod.
0.3.0: Preview pictures. Put a mod on, take a screenshot, and press "Use my last screenshot" (or pick any picture file). The picture shows on the mod's card as you arrow through the list. "Adjust framing" zooms in and moves the view so your character fills the picture. New filter: with a picture or no picture yet. Pictures are copies kept in the plugin's own folder.
0.2.1: Your Penumbra folders now show up (newer Penumbra keeps them in mod_data.db; it's read from a copy, so Penumbra's file is never touched). The folder filter lists sub-folders too (picking one includes everything inside it). Your Penumbra tags and notes show on the card and are searchable. "From the mod itself" is now a folded section, closed until you open it.
0.2.0: Info card. For each mod you can tick Favorite, pick a type (Gear, Hair, Body, Tattoo, Jewelry, Emote, FX, Furniture, Pet, Other), and fill in Made for, your own tags and notes. Everything you type is searchable. New filters: type (including "not set") and Favorites only. Favorites get a gold star in the list.
0.1.1: Arrow keys no longer walk your character. Click a mod (or the search box) and the up and down arrows move through the list; Page Up and Page Down jump 10. Also added Previous and Next buttons.
0.1.0: First version. A searchable list of every mod in your Penumbra folder, in your own Penumbra folder order. Search names, folders, authors, tags and descriptions; filter by top folder; scroll with the arrow keys. Shows where each mod sits in Penumbra, with Copy name and Copy full path buttons. /lookingglass or /lglass to open.
